_provenance.note: tgId 30 (AES-256, direction=decrypt, internalTestType=MMT), tcId 2129, the group's first test case. Independently re-verified against Node's crypto (OpenSSL) oracle before use. Replaces a self-generated (Node-oracle) vector — WS-7 of the 2026-08-28 continuation plan. This is a RAW block-cipher CBC vector (no PKCS#7 padding), which is what NIST's ACVP-AES-CBC algorithm actually tests; the wiring was changed from CKM_AES_CBC_PAD to CKM_AES_CBC (hsm_aesDecrypt's new 'cbc-raw' mode) to match, rather than re-padding the vector to fit the old (arbitrarily chosen) padded mechanism.
